title: T Cell Isolation from Mouse Tissues
author: Kristin Anderson
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.sqnedve
materials: Quench lysis using 10mL T cell media.

steps.title: Harvest and process spleen cells
steps.instruction: Isolate and prepare cells from the mouse spleen.

substeps.instruction: Harvest cells by smashing spleen through a 70um filter
Spin down cells at 369 xg for 4-5 minutes at 4C
Remove supernatant and lyse red blood cells with 2 mL ACK lysis buffer for 2 minutes at room temperature
Quench lysis using 10mL T cell media
Spin down cells at 369 xg for 4-5 minutes at 4C
Remove supernatant and resuspend cells in T cell media
Store on ice until use

steps.title: Perform secondary red blood cell lysis
steps.instruction: Conduct additional lysis cycles to ensure removal of red blood cells.

substeps.instruction: Spin down cells at 369 xg for 4-5 minutes at 4C
Remove supernatant and lyse red blood cells with 2 mL ACK lysis buffer for 2 minutes at room temperature
Quench lysis using 2mL T cell media
Spin down cells at 369 xg for 4-5 minutes at 4C
Remove supernatant and lyse red blood cells a second time with 2 mL ACK lysis buffer for 2 minutes at room temperature
Quench lysis using 2mL T cell media
Spin down cells at 369 xg for 4-5 minutes at 4C
Remove supernatant and resuspend cells in T cell media
Store on ice until use

steps.title: Excise and prepare tumor tissue
steps.instruction: Isolate tumor tissue and perform initial mechanical dissociation.

substeps.instruction: Excise tumor from animal and remove normal tissue, including any lymph nodes from tumor
Store tumor in RPMI containing 5% FBS on ice until processing
Transfer tumor tissue into 3mL RPMI+5%FBS in a GentleMACs C tube
Mince tumors using a GentleMACS dissociator (Miltenyi) using protocol 'm_imptumor_01'
Transfer tissue to a 50 mL conical tube
Add 35 mL of collagenase (pre-warmed to 37C)
Place tubes on a MACS Mix Rotator in a 37C incubator rotating on medium speed for 10 minutes

steps.title: Filter and wash tumor cells
steps.instruction: Remove debris and wash the digested tumor cells.

substeps.instruction: Spin down tubes at 369 xg for 4-5 minutes at 4C
Remove supernatant and resuspend tissue in 5mL RPMI+5%FBS
Smash sample through a 70um filter
Spin down tubes at 369 xg for 4-5 minutes at 4C

steps.title: Purify cells via Percoll gradient
steps.instruction: Separate cells using a density gradient centrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend pellet in 5mL of 44% Percoll
Underlay with 3-5mL of 67% Percoll
Spin samples for 20 minutes at 809 xg at room temperature with NO BRAKE
Remove and discard fat layer floating on top
Gently remove the cells at the interface and transfer to a fresh tube

steps.title: Final wash and storage
steps.instruction: Perform final wash and prepare cells for downstream use.

substeps.instruction: Wash cells with 15mL RPMI+5% FBS
Spin cells at 518 xg for 10 minutes at 4C
Remove supernatant
Resuspend cells in either RPMI+5% FBS and store on ice until use, or proceed directly to cell staining for FACS
